channel.title: The Honolulu Star-Advertiser - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Honolulu Star-Advertiser (staradvertiser.com)

item.title: Woman, 82, who died after being run over in Punahou area IDed
item.description: The Honolulu Medical Examiner’s office has identified the pedestrian who died after being run over and pinned by an SUV last week as Kin Leung Lau, 82, of Honolulu.

item.title: Apple launches iPhone 17e at $599, boosts base storage
item.description: Apple today launched iPhone 17e, its more affordable smartphone model that starts at a price of $599 with 256 gigabytes of storage, as it looks to defend its share in a fiercely competitive global handset market.

item.title: CDC acting director Bhattacharya urges use of measles vaccine
item.description: The U.S. Centers for Disease Control and Prevention’s new acting director, Jay Bhattacharya, today urged Americans to get vaccinated against measles, saying it was the best protection against the disease.

item.title: Woman, 70s, airlifted from Waahila Ridge with ankle injury
item.description: Honolulu firefighters rescued an injured woman from the Waahila Ridge Trail at Saint Louis Heights on Sunday evening.

item.title: U.S.-Iran conflict sparks worst flight disruption since pandemic
item.description: LONDON/SYDNEY >> Travel shares tumbled today, shedding $22.6 billion as escalating conflict between the U.S., Israel and Iran disrupted flights worldwide, closed key Middle Eastern hubs and sent oil prices surging, with analysts warning of weeks of disruption.

item.title: Search underway for Maui Humane Society’s new CEO
item.description: A search is underway for a new chief executive officer for the Maui Humane Society in Puunene.

item.title: Clinton says Trump told him of ‘some great times’ with Jeffrey Epstein
item.description: WASHINGTON >> Former President Bill Clinton told lawmakers that President Donald Trump told him he had “some great times” with convicted sex offender Jeffrey Epstein before their relationship soured, according to a video released on Monday.

item.title: Navy petty officer sentenced to prison in sextortion case
item.description: A 22-year-old Navy petty officer who sextorted children into cutting themselves for him was sentenced to more than eight years in federal prison today and ordered to pay restitution to 11 underage victims, according to U.S. District Court records.

item.title: Honolulu Roofing Company to close operations in May
item.description: The Honolulu Roofing Company Inc. is shutting down its operations in about two months, according to a filing with the state Department of Labor and Relations.

item.title: Ewa Beach man, 70s, critical after car falls on top of him
item.description: A man in his 70s was critically injured after a vehicle he was working on apparently fell onto him this afternoon in Ewa Beach, according to first responders.
